dict.string: Keywright records from a microphone or other audio input only when an agent you approved asks it to (record_audio) while Keywright is unlocked. The recording is saved as a file on this Mac and never sent anywhere. Locking Keywright stops it and deletes the file.

Keywright takes a still from a camera (including a Continuity Camera iPhone) only when an agent you approved asks it to (capture_camera_frame) while Keywright is unlocked. The picture is saved as a file on this Mac and given to that agent, never sent anywhere else.
